notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 and macOS
notes.notes:
There is now a macOS version!
Some of few may have noticed that the demo is now available for macOS! I hadn't announced anything yet as I was testing things out and was planning to add a few fixes while at it. 

Though the macOS is available, I haven't had the chance to try to run it on older macOS devices. If you happen to run into any problems, feel free to let me know!

Bug Fixes
macOS: There were issues with the double click as macOS seems to not register double clicks the same way and stopped from continuously double clicking blocks to rotate them easily.

Minor UI stuff

Some settings weren't being saved properly.

The scrolling on menus didn't work properly when using sliders.

Small graphical stuff. Probably wouldn't have been noticeable. But I noticed.
QOL Changes
It's now also possible to click Elfie's thought bubble to start the dialogue. \[EDIT: This may have not made it in.]

Space Bar added to be able to continue Elfie's dialogue. Currently it's not possible to remap it but I'll be working on adding that feature to the General options for release and possibly updating it in the demo too.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
When going to the Credits when pausing the game, the player would stay stuck there and have to force quit the game. That should be fixed now.
Gameplay Changes
Modified the hit boxes for the triangular shapes and the stairs. It should be easier to pickup blocks that are behind them and make selecting the block you want to pickup behind other blocks more accurate.
Language
Fixed some Japanese translations that we're mismatch.

notes.title: Elfie: A Sand Plan Demo Release Date - August 7th
notes.notes:
And it's part of the Wholesome Games Celebration!! 

I'm super happy to announce that not only will the demo for Elfie: A Sand Plan be released on August 7th, but also that it will be part of the "New Demos" section of the Wholesome Games Celebration!!

The event starts August 7th and lasts until the 14th!
I'm excited to see all the other lineup of games showcased alongside Elfie. And have fun checking out the event!

"And playing our demo hehe", you hear Elfie whisper in the background.
